blocks.text: Quiet time is the time set aside to meet with God. It is the time set aside to communicate with the Father through the living Word with the assistance of the Holy Spirit. It is also a time to bring our request to God in prayer. Through Quiet Time we cultivate a relationship with God. In this study, we shall also discuss how to have effective quiet time on a daily basis with God.
Why the need for quiet time

items: We need God's power to cope with the daily activities. {{1kgs 19:7|I Kings 19:7}}, {{jo 15:5|John 15:5}}, Is 40:28-31
We pattern our lives after our Lord Jesus Christ's life by following His steps. {{mt 14:23|Mt. 14:23}}, Mk1:35, {{1pe 2:21|I Pet 2:21}}
To cultivate a personal habit of worshipping the Lord and thereby help our personal devotion. {{1pe 2:2|I Pet. 2:2}}, {{js 1:8,js 1:9|Josh 1:8-9}}, {{ps 1:1,ps 1:2,ps 1:3,ps 95:6|Ps. 1:1-3, 95:6}}

To create a personal adjus tment to the teaching of the Bible, i.e. living by the Word, reacting positively or negatively to the Bible. {{jo 1:21,jo 1:22,jo 1:23,jo 1:24,jo 1:25|John. 1:21-25}}, {{mt 4:4|Matt 4:4}}, {{1pe 2:2|I Pet. 2:2}}, {{jm 1:21,jm 1:22,jm 1:23,jm 1:24,jm 1:25|James 1:21-25}}

To create right reaction to trials and temptations that befall us. Substance already imparted help to react. I Pet. 1L3-7, {{hb 12:10,hb 12:11,hb 12:12,hb 12:13|Heb. 12:10-13}}, {{jm 1:2,jm 1:3,jm 1:4|James 1:2-4}}
The Holy Bible (it is advisable to have more than one version and a good reference of the Bible at your side).
Hymn book/chorus book and dictionary
Notebook and pen
List of prayer points
Aid, Daily Power, Everyday with Jesus etc.

blocks.text: Time and place of quiet time

items: Frequency: At least once a day. {{dn 6:10|Dan. 6:10}}
Period of the day: At an acceptable time, preferably early in the morning {{mk 1:35|Mk. 1:35}}; {{prv 8:17|Prov. 8:17}}; {{ps 5:3|Ps. 5:3}}; {{gn 19:27|Gen. 19:27}}
Waking thoughts are focused on God.
Strength is received to meet the challenges of the day. {{eph 6:10,eph 6:11,eph 6:12|Eph. 6:10-12}}
Place: A quite place.
Durations: To be determined by the Believer such that it does not encroach on another activity for the day.
Begin with a short prayer. {{ps 119:18|Ps. 119:18}}; {{jo 16:13,jo 16:14,jo 16:15|John 16:13-15}}
Sing a few songs/chorus.
Read slowly and meditatively through a predetermined portion of the Bible ({{ps 119:18|Ps. 119:18}};
providing answers to the following questions where applicable:
What is the main subject of the passage or book?
Who are the persons revealed in the passage?
Who is speaking? About who is he speaking?
What is the key verse(s) of the passage?
Is there any sin for me to confess and forsake? {{prv 28:13|Prov. 28:13}}
Is there any commandment for me to obey?
Is there any error for me to avoid?
Is there any promise for me to claim?

blocks.text: d. Prayer: Intercession, thanksgiving, adoration, supplication ({{ph 4:6,ph 4:7,ph 4:8|Phil. 4:6-8}}, {{1tm 2:1,1tm 2:2,1tm 2:3|1Tim. 2:1-3}}). During the course of the quite time, it is important that the following be done:

I. Write down on a notebook, sins to be confessed and commandments to be obeyed. II. Passages to be memorized. III. Meditate on the portion read. Some of the benefits of meditation on the Word of God are: {{js 1:8,js 1:9|Josh. 1:8-9}}; {{ps 119:97|Ps. 119:97}}

o The Word will become real to you. o The Holy Spirit will apply the Word of God to your life and problems. o The soul learns to blame itself when it detects faults and adores and loves the Lord o Determine to obey the Word of God. {{jm 1:21,jm 1:22,jm 1:23,jm 1:24,jm 1:25|James 1:21-25}}; {{2tm 3:16,2tm 3:17|II Tim. 3:16-17}} o List out areas which the Word of God has touched you and pray on each of them.
Methods of Bible study during quiet time
o By chapters o By topics o By paragraphs o Through biography o By verses o Study outlines, e.g. Daily Bread o By books o Everyday with Jesus
The methods suggested are not exhaustive. Use all the Bible study methods available to avoid monotony. Benefits of quiet time:

items: Provides an opportunity for the soul to linger in the presence of God, laying your innermost being before Him.
Entering a reverent an affectionate yet fruitful conference with Him. It creates an atmosphere where God speaks to you and you speak back to Him.
Working knowledge of the Bible.
Desire to know God and to do His will.

blocks.text: How Does God Speak to us

items: The Still Small Voice {{1kgs 19:12|I Kings 19:12}}
Inward Witness {{prv 20:27|Prov. 20:27}}; {{1co 2:11|I Cor. 2:11}}
Audible Voice {{act 10:13|Acts 10:13}}; {{1sm 3:4|I Sam. 3:4}}

Through the gifts of the Holy Spirit, e.g. prophecy, word of wisdom, word of knowledge etc. {{1co 14:3,1co 14:4|I Cor 14: 3-4}}; {{2pe 1:19,2pe 1:20,2pe 1:21|II Pet 1: 19-21}}; {{dt 18:20,dt 18:21|Deut 18: 20-21}}

blocks.text: Obstacles to effective quiet timeDiscuss possible obstacles to a fruitful quiet time--Haste, disturbance, bad planning, laziness, over-eating, monotony due to using one method of study.

conclusion.text: A fruitful and consistent quiet time brings out a balanced spiritual development in at least three different areas:

items: Fruitful Prayer Life: Pr. 28:9; 15:8, 29
